quests.title: Timmie's Wish

dialogue.t: Ah, you saw my commission, didn't you?
So did you get those ten spikes of Wheat?
Yup, this should do it! Thanks for helping me out. Take these, please.
Ten spikes of Wheat... We can make something delicious out of that for sure!

quests.description: Timmie from Mondstadt needs ten servings of Wheat.
